module.purpose: Defines the client-side provider composition for the web application, supplying session, RPC, SVG cache, web push, notification sound, and conditional chat contexts around rendered application content.
module.summary: This client module centralizes application-wide React context composition. It nests authentication and RPC providers, conditionally mounts chat and notification behavior based on the current route and embed mode, and wraps children with caching and web-push functionality.
module.businessContext: Supports the web scheduling product’s authenticated sessions, notifications, chat, and embedded booking experiences. Failure can leave pages without core context, realtime notification behavior, or route-specific UI integrations.
functions: Providers (~L17-32): Composes application context providers and conditionally renders route-specific integrations.

sectionMap.intent: Mounts notification sounds only outside embeds and booking pages.

units.name: Providers

detail.name: Providers
detail.signature: export function Providers({ isEmbed, children }: ProvidersProps)
preconditions: The argument conforms to ProvidersProps and supplies isEmbed and children.
postconditions: Returns a provider tree rooted at SessionProvider and containing TrpcProvider, CacheProvider, and WebPushProvider around the supplied children.
Renders PlainChat when the current route is not a booking page.
Renders NotificationSoundHandler only when the current route is not a booking page and isEmbed is false.
invariants: The supplied children remain nested inside WebPushProvider.
PlainChat is never rendered on a booking page.
NotificationSoundHandler is never rendered on a booking page or in embed mode.
edgeCases: On a booking page, PlainChat and NotificationSoundHandler are omitted while the provider hierarchy and children remain rendered.
When isEmbed is true on a non-booking page, PlainChat is rendered but NotificationSoundHandler is omitted.
When isEmbed is false on a non-booking page, both PlainChat and NotificationSoundHandler are rendered.
detail.summary: Provides the application context hierarchy for session, tRPC, caching, and web push functionality. It conditionally renders chat and notification behavior based on booking-page and embed state while preserving the supplied children.

specTests.then: The rendered tree contains SessionProvider, TrpcProvider, CacheProvider, and WebPushProvider around the children, and also contains PlainChat and NotificationSoundHandler.
The rendered tree contains PlainChat but does not contain NotificationSoundHandler, while preserving the provider hierarchy and children.

specTests.when: Providers is rendered with either value of isEmbed
specTests.then: Neither PlainChat nor NotificationSoundHandler is rendered, while the provider hierarchy and children remain present.
